sources.title: README.md · acyildirimer/Qwen3.6-27B-int4-AutoRound at main
sources.snippet: Model details This model is an INT4 quantized version of the original Qwen3.6-27B model. Quantization was performed with AutoRound using a custom calibration dataset. The calibration set consists of 128 randomly selected samples from diverse categories, with sequence length 2048 and 300 optimization iterations.

sources.snippet: Qwen 3.6 27B is the first open coding model that runs on a single 24GB GPU and gets within 4 points of Claude Opus 4.6 on SWE-bench. Here's how to run it.
